permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Captures nearby conversation to suggest replies on the glasses. Audio streams to Deepgram for transcription (your own API key, or your personal Worker) and is never stored. Transcribed text IS saved on your phone (last 50 sessions, other speakers only), clearable in settings. Mic is OFF by default.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends audio to Deepgram and transcript context to Anthropic or OpenAI using API keys you paste in phone settings; keys stay on your phone. Optionally routes through your own Cloudflare Worker instead. No other hosts.
